# Archived — Legacy Master Files (do not edit)

**Archived:** 2026-05-23
**Reason:** Periodic-audit E.x.a — single-source-of-truth consolidation.

These files were active during the manual's 2025 development cycle but are **no longer part of the production pipeline**. They are preserved here for historical reference only.

The canonical source for the DeSilva tutorial manual is the parent folder's `COMPLETE-OPUS-MASTER.md`. The PDF build pipeline (`engineering/document-production/workspace/p2-pasm-desilva-style/`) reads only that file.

---

## Contents

| File | What it was | Why archived |
|------|-------------|--------------|
| `CHAPTERS-7-16-ENHANCED.md` | January 2025 enhanced master for chapters 7–16, generated by Claude Opus 4.1 as an enhancement over the original stubs | Content was merged into `COMPLETE-OPUS-MASTER.md` after generation. The standalone file then stopped receiving subsequent audit fixes and now carries known-fixed regressions (`--ptra++` syntax bug, fabricated `INT_PINRISE` constant, stale RDLONG/WRLONG timing claims). |
| `README-CHAPTERS-7-16-ENHANCED.md` | README documenting the above | Companion to archived file |
| `COMBINED-COMPLETE-MASTER.md` | Intended production-ready combination of master + enhanced chapters | Never fully generated — only 219 lines of front matter were ever written. Build pipeline doesn't use it. |
| `README-COMBINED-MASTER.md` | README documenting the above | Companion to archived file |
| `LABELS-SECTION-FOR-INSERT.md` | December 2025 staging snippet introducing the Labels section to Chapter 3 | Content was merged into `COMPLETE-OPUS-MASTER.md` via commit `0b6fe18` (2025-12-06). The standalone file is the original staging document, no longer needed. |

---

## How this was determined

Per `../../audit/dual-master-resolution-2026-05-23.md`:

1. The workspace README (`engineering/document-production/workspace/p2-pasm-desilva-style/README.md`) explicitly names `COMPLETE-OPUS-MASTER.md` as the single content source for PDF production.
2. The build manifest (`request.json`) reads a single input file (no combine step).
3. The shipped production file matches `COMPLETE-OPUS-MASTER.md` line-for-line (6,280 lines).
4. The shipped file diverges from `CHAPTERS-7-16-ENHANCED.md` in both content and formatting.

---

## If you need the historical content

The files remain in git history. They can be read here without disturbing the production folder. Do **not** edit them — any edits will be lost on the next periodic audit.

If you find yourself needing to revive any of this material, the right approach is to merge the relevant content into `../COMPLETE-OPUS-MASTER.md` directly, then keep this archive as the record.
